summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. All 39 tests in test/test_path.py and the 18 new SHACL tests pass under the shared venv. Nothing was committed. Not verified: ruff, black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so the lint and type-check gates did not run. mypy will likely flag the Optional return of graph.value passed into the parser, and the operator lines in the tests may need type-ignore comments. Line lengths were checked by hand and are within 88 columns.
